entry.name: HandSense (Glove2Hand)
entry.title: Glove2Hand: Synthesizing Natural Hand-Object Interaction from Multi-Modal Sensing Gloves
entry.summary: 5 subjects wore a Meta Reality Labs research glove with 5 capacitive fingertip tactile sensors and 12 IMUs, filmed by egocentric grayscale headset cameras with marker mocap, over 6 tasks and 10 objects; matching bare-hand sessions and Glove2Hand-synthesized bare-hand videos are included.
entry.hand: Meta Reality Labs research sensing glove (12 IMUs, 5 capacitive fingertip sensors)

sensor.note: One continuous force channel per fingertip, synchronized to the egocentric frames by nearest timestamp (paper). Released file format not checked (request form not submitted).

scale.text: ~200K images, 5 subjects, 10 objects, 6 tasks; one glove session and one bare-hand session per subject, 2-5 min per task segment

entry.access: Google Form (name, affiliation, email); the download link is shown on the confirmation page after submitting.
caveats: Tactile and IMU signals exist only for the glove session; bare-hand contact labels are manual binary per-fingertip annotations.
The paper defers glove details: 'More detailed information about the glove configuration will be shared upon acceptance'.
Release contents (raw glove video, synthesized bare-hand video, sensor files) were not checked; the request form was not submitted.
The project page says larger dataset releases are planned.

tracking.note: retro-reflective markers on the dorsal glove or hand; ground-truth 3D hand pose for both sessions
glove session; used as pseudo ground truth for occluded hand tracking

other: Glove2Hand-synthesized bare-hand videos of the glove sessions
manual binary fingertip contact labels (bare-hand session)

unconfirmed: Headset not named; the paper says 'egocentric grayscale video recordings from headset cameras' and 'our egocentric headset provides only two closely positioned cameras'. Camera type left null (grayscale is not a schema type).
Whether one or both hands wore the glove is not stated.
frames=200,000 is Table 6's 'Images' count; whether it counts both cameras, both sessions or synthesized frames is not stated.
Tactile and IMU rates not stated (glove 'streams sensor data at high framerates').
No license on the project page, the form or in the paper; the arXiv paper itself is CC BY 4.0, which covers the paper only.

Affiliations: paper lists Meta Reality Labs and Rutgers University (Abdeslam Boularias); first author worked on it during a Meta internship. The glove is called 'our research platform'; maker taken as Meta Reality Labs from that context.
